compiled_state.title: [test-merge-to-main]: State/phase tests fail -> 5+1 pre-existing CI failures blocking PR merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

6 pre-existing test failures blocking CI (Script Tests required check) on PR #47.

Confirmed pre-existing: main CI failed after PR #45 merged (2026-05-04T22:25:07Z).
Tests added in commit eb1e17b6e4 (split merge-to-main into dispatcher+strategy scripts).

Failing tests in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh:
- test_state_write_phase_updates_current_phase
- test_state_write_phase_overwrites_previous
- test_state_record_merge_sha_writes_sha
- test_state_merge_sha_recorded
- test_sigurg_records_interrupted_phase

Failing test in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh:
- t_pr_poll_succeeds_on_merged_state_exit_zero

Hypothesis: Tests reference functions (_state_write_phase, _state_record_merge_sha etc.) 
that were split out in eb1e17b6e4 but may not exist or have changed signatures. 
Or tests are RED tests that need .test-index RED markers.

comments.body: Verified resolved: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh runs 69/69 PASS locally; main CI run 25411652624 (2026-05-06T01:31Z) shows Script Tests=success + Hook Tests=success. Functions _state_write_phase, _state_record_merge_sha defined in plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh and discovered by _extract_fn fallback. No further action needed.
